title: oncostylus pusillus
intro: Oncostylus pusillus, commonly known as Indian spurge, is a plant species native to various regions of the world, including the Indian subcontinent, Southeast Asia, and parts of Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as aiding in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Oncostylus pusillus include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
